turns.speaker: Uncle Henry
turns.clean_spoken_text: There's a cyclone coming, Em. I'll go look after the stock.

speech_metadata.style: laconic, urgent, weathered shouting over distant wind

turns.speaker: Narrator
turns.clean_spoken_text: Then he ran toward the sheds where the cows and horses were kept. Aunt Em dropped her work and came to the door. One glance told her of the danger close at hand.

turns.speaker: Aunt Em
turns.clean_spoken_text: Quick, Dorothy! <screams> Run for the cellar!

turns.speaker: Narrator
turns.clean_spoken_text: Toto jumped out of Dorothy's arms and hid under the bed, and the girl started to get him.
